card.name: Pointing to where content is placed
card.fires_on: Small location words after a verb like provided, listed, place or writes, which point to where something goes or appears. Most often "Table" or "Tables" after "provided in".

modes.label: Pointer to a table
modes.description: The word Table or in after "provided in" or "below", just before a table number.
